summary: Moxi 2.18.3 consolidates immutable desktop bundle updates, exact rollback, installed macOS and Linux startup evidence, distributed Agent replacement safety, and release evidence into one version-aligned operational contract.

notes: Workbench remains a streamed protocol client with stable GUI and Python WASM DSL action contracts.
Workflow, solver, research, and evidence operations remain language-neutral behind the desktop shell.
Hub packages the synchronized 2.18.3 documentation, brand, and language-pack contracts.
Project, runtime, release, and diagnostics journeys retain native desktop command boundaries.
Workbench packages the complete 30-locale language-pack set and current workflow contracts.
GUI and Python WASM DSL operations continue to share product-owned actions.
Installer treats Hub, Workbench, and Installer as one immutable SHA-256-bound desktop bundle set.
Activation history, tamper detection, atomic updates, and exact rollback are visible and testable.
Ubuntu host installation validates one current-version package per shell, installs through fail-closed apt privileges, and verifies all /usr/bin entrypoints.
Headless and distributed control paths remain decoupled from all desktop shells.
Agent lifecycle generations fence stale controllers, executions, and replacement events.

capabilities: ONNX-like workflow datasets and versioned graph contracts
mixed-physics operator composition through TaskIR and engine protocols
restart-safe orchestration with persisted outcomes and bounded recovery
Rust-only worker/operator extension SDK remains distinct from headless control SDKs
operator descriptors, package preflight, TaskIR, and reliability evidence remain release-gated
solver execution remains language-neutral across direct, Agent RPC, and workflow paths
